line: Nothing's wrong with your n8n AI agent. It's forgetting on purpose — once per 5 messages.
That number, 5, is the Agent node's default memory window. No one sets it — it just ships that way.
Ask it a question. Follow up six messages later, and it has no idea what you're talking about.
To whoever's talking to it, that looks like your bot forgot the conversation two seconds in.
The fix: raise the context window — 20 to 50 exchanges covers a normal conversation.
And if you're running queue mode, Simple Memory doesn't even survive across workers — switch to Postgres or Redis memory instead.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
